research: Read docs/research/2026-10-black-friday-and-bag-ads.md: statics win with one big visual and one offer line; flat lays, gift styling and 'what fits' scenes beat busy lifestyle (Bluedrop, Promer, Bellroy, Dagne Dover); kept every static to one idea, minimal words.

Read the packet's earlier-batch list (B011, B014, B016): their headlines (Everything fits, Phone. Keys. Cards. Done., Gift sorted, Both hands free, Big bag. Zero mess ...) and scenes (cafe chair, back pocket, gift styling, dark luxe) are not reused; new scenes here: wrapping table, entryway bench, flat lay of the day, travel bench, autumn wall, plum velvet, coat hook, gold-on-black.

Read the Black Friday Sale 2026 facts: 60% only for 2-3 bags together, free jewellery box with 2 bags, sale runs to 30 November; the Hobo Bag itself stays 50% off. This is a winners batch: the five winner videos keep their RAW bodies, so only the statics are new; the one project below is a stand-in the winners pipeline does not render (the sheet format needs a project for its statics to belong to).

projects.title: One for you, one for her
projects.big_idea: A bundle walk-through: pick two Hobo Bags in two colours, one for you and one for her, and see what each bag does and what two bags unlock this Black Friday.
projects.why_new: No earlier batch told the bundle story: two bags, 60% off together, the free jewellery box, in the order of the bag's features.

chapters.text: Here is how Black Friday works at Libra Cases. You get sixty percent off the regular price when you buy two bags together. Pick one for you and one for her.
Start with the leather. It is soft and water-resistant, it looks expensive, and it only gets better with time.
Turn it around and there is a hidden pocket on the back. It sits flat against you, so your passport and cards stay right there.
Two gold side zips, one on each side, keep your keys and phone close.
Open it up and divided compartments keep everything in its place, so nothing sinks to the bottom.
Two straps let you wear it on the shoulder, as a handbag, or crossbody, whoever carries it.
Every Hobo Bag comes with a free matching pouch wallet, and it is fifty percent off right now.
Buy two bags and you also get a free jewellery box, while stocks last. The Black Friday sale runs until the thirtieth of November. Tap the link below.
